title: GTA 6 Softlock Bug Keeps You From Finishing the Main Story
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 suffers from an unfortunate softlock bug that prevents players from completing the main story, but a fix is available.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Softlock Bug Keeps You From Finishing the Main Story

As players dive deep into the massive world of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, technical hurdles are bound to surface. According to a recent report by GameRant on November 26, 2026, *GTA 6* currently suffers from an unfortunate softlock bug that stops players from completing the main story. 

### The Impact of the Softlock Bug

For a massive open-world title, reaching the conclusion of the narrative is a primary goal for many players. However, running into a softlock during critical moments of the campaign can completely halt progress, leaving players unable to finish the game. While frustrating, it is a reminder of the complex scripting challenges that often accompany sprawling modern video game releases.

### Finding a Way Around the Issue

Fortunately, players who encounter this progression blocker are not entirely out of luck. According to the source material, there is a way to fix the issue and bypass the softlock, allowing players to continue their journey through the main story. While we can anticipate that Rockstar Games will likely address such critical progression bugs in future patches, having an immediate workaround is a huge relief for eager fans.

### Editor's Take

It is not entirely unexpected for a massive open-world release like *GTA 6* to encounter occasional progression bugs. Fortunately, this specific softlock has a known fix, meaning players don't have to put their playthroughs on permanent hold. We hope the developers deploy a permanent fix soon to ensure a smooth storytelling experience for everyone.
